evidence: Offline single-column calculations, no new CM1 or GCM runs. CM1: one realization each of the sea box's third lunar day and the land box's second, their domain means every 3 hours (59 a quarter) and their 3-D output's cloud samples; the scheme meets columns CM1's own convection shaped, so its response at once and CM1's realised convection are compared. GCM: 3-day means of five years of the rh 0.7 branch in its site cells, built by the simplified Betts-Miller scheme; the boundary layer's forcing there lacks the dynamics' heating and takes the radiation and the dynamics' moistening as single-step snapshots. The single column is driven by CM1's radiation and surface fluxes, not its own, with a mixed boundary layer in place of PlaSim's vertical diffusion. The adjustment time's factor and the entrainment are measured on these boxes, so their sea quarters are not independent tests of them. Costs are counts of exponentials scaled by the Betts-Miller scheme's measured cost, not a Fortran timing.
reading_rule: Quarters of the lunar day at each site by hour angle from noon (night -180 to -90, morning -90 to 0, afternoon 0 to 90, evening 90 to 180). Precipitation in mm/day: formed, what the scheme forms in its updraught; handed_on, net of its downdraught's evaporation, as PlaSim's mkrain would take it; ground, after mkrain's evaporation at the site's CM1 constant (gamma_site, sea 0.027, land 0.046) and at PlaSim's 0.01. CM1's falling_formed is the water falling from its clouds (evaporated on the way down plus reaching the ground, cm1out_stats). Mass fluxes in kg/m2/s at profile_heights_m, the scheme's updraught and downdraught (negative) means over all outputs, CM1's sampled cloudy updraught and core over its domain. Heating (K/day) and moistening (g/kg/day) profiles and the band sums (W/m2, mm/day): the scheme's convection with mkrain's evaporation and melting, against CM1's microphysics, resolved transport and boundary-layer scheme. type_share: shares of outputs by type (None: no convection). Cloud tops: the scheme's where its updraught's kinetic energy runs out; CM1's the top of each column's lowest unbroken cloud with its base below 16 km. tau: CM1's removal of the scheme's PCAPE (Pa/s) by its own convective tendencies, the updraught held. single_column: temperature of each lunar day's mean minus CM1's mean over the span (K) at the listed heights; rain at the ground by quarter in the last lunar day.
